_meta.purpose: The Phase 4 engines of ATLAS_FRAMEWORK_REVIEW.md Section 15.2 (Section 17 Phase 4; Section 21 V8, V9, V11). Read by phase4-engines.sh, phase4/lib-engine.sh (each phase4/engines/<key>.sh reads its own entry) and phase4/engines/p4common.py. Meditron-70B and the vision engine (Qwen2.5-VL-72B) are Phase 3 GGUF engines and are not listed (Section 15.2, 17 step 2).
_meta.tier_rule: green: built in step 02 in list order, a failure is recorded fail and the phase continues. yellow: attempted in step 03, a failure is recorded deferred. verify: step 04, records verify_id (V8 pointllm, V9 clay-prithvi) pass or deferred. deferred: listed for the table only, no build_script, never attempted (Section 15.2 says why).
_meta.order_rule: List order is Section 17 step 2's order of value; the driver keeps it.
_meta.hf_rule: hf_repos[] is what the engine pulls with huggingface_hub.snapshot_download through the allowlist proxy (HF_HOME=/srv/atlas/engines/hf). gated=true repos get HF_TOKEN from /etc/atlas/secrets/hf-token.env and fail with the exact licence URL on 401/403 (research conflict 16). verified=false means the repo id, size or licence came from a search snippet (rocm-containers.md: huggingface.co was blocked in the research sandbox); p4common.py re-reads https://huggingface.co/api/models/<repo> (gated, cardData.license, siblings) at pull time and records it in $HF_HOME/manifests/<repo>.json. allow_patterns limits the pull (FLUX: skip the 24 GB single-file duplicates).
_meta.pip_rule: pip[] is installed into /srv/atlas/engines/venv/<key> (a --system-site-packages venv over the image's ROCm torch) under the image's /opt/atlas/constraints-rocm.txt, so no engine pin can replace the gfx1151 torch (rocm-containers.md §4 item 2, §6.6). Pins are typed only where the research gives one (rule §7.9); unpinned entries say so in research_note.
_meta.footprint_rule: footprint_gb_expected is Section 15.2's planning figure. The measured value is the GTT counter delta (mem_info_gtt_used) on the host while the engine's test runs, written to $ATLAS_STATE/phase4/<key>.json as footprint_mb and registered with the Arbiter in step 05.
_meta.timeout_rule: timeout_s bounds one engine's script (build + pull + test); load_timeout_s is the in-test watchdog for a hung model load (kernel 7.0 mmap/hang reports, ROCm/legacy-rocm-build #6530): a load slower than this is killed and recorded fail, never waited for.
